about.label: 04 / ABOUT ME
about.heading:
One creative.
A few ways to
bring ideas to life.
about.location:
BASED IN ZAMBIA
OPEN TO REMOTE PROJECTS WORLDWIDE
paragraphs: I’m the creative behind Tedits Studio, an independent web-design practice based in Zambia.
I enjoy bringing structure and personality together—choosing colours, typography, and layouts that help a business express itself clearly online.
Beyond web design, I make music, edit videos, and create motion graphics. Working across sound and visuals shapes how I think about rhythm, attention, and the feeling a design leaves behind.
I’m available for local projects and remote work with overseas clients. If you’re starting something new or rethinking an existing website, I’d love to hear what you have in mind.
